harness.name: Vulnhuntr
harness.description: Zero-shot vulnerability discovery with LLMs: traces code paths to find remotely exploitable bugs.

uses.quote: Vulnhuntr leverages the power of LLMs to automatically create and analyze entire code call chains starting from remote user input and ending at server output for detection of complex, multi-step, security-bypassing
The final analysis consists of it's reasoning, a proof of concept exploit, and a confidence score
